evidence: Modifies core wallet spending (src/wallet/spend.cpp), coin selection, fee bumping (src/wallet/feebumper.cpp), and wallet database persistence.
rationale: Adds wallet support for creating and fee-bumping transactions paying to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses. It delivers substantial user value by enabling receiver privacy and address reuse prevention, addressing the long-standing limitation tracked in #28536 where Bitcoin Core could not pay Silent Payment recipients.
